vb_textbox.text: Since the time to make decisions is very short, I thought it was best not to focus on finding a pattern. I did not try to figure out if the 's' and 'k' gets should get switched off or if there was a color that produces more mushrooms. After doing a couple of trails with pressing the keys, I believed that the 's' key would get me more points compared to the 'k' key. I would have switched keys if I had gotten three 0 points in a row. Luckily, I never did. It is best to stick to one side which was 's' for me.
